content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 7.7 was the sole liquidated-damages mechanic in the agreement, and it ran against us — 15% of annual Fees per week for a late invoice, expressly labelled liquidated damages. No early-termination fee or other Customer-payable stipulated amount exists elsewhere (§ 27 confirms termination for force majeure is "without penalty"; §§ 7.3 and 21 impose nothing of this kind).

Because the charge is triggered by a minor payment delay and compounds without limit, it fails the fallback (sole early-termination fee capped at three months' fees) and reaches walk-away territory. I took the preferred position with a single surgical replacement: delete the charge and state unconditionally that no liquidated damages or penalties are payable by us, leaving the rest of § 7 intact and with no dangling cross-references.
